name: Indesit IDHE80WIRE — Heat Pump Tumble Dryer
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk.
description: The Indesit IDHE80WIRE is an 8kg heat pump tumble dryer in white that recycles warm air for gentle, efficient drying. Push&Go one-touch daily cycle, a Mix cycle for up to 4kg of mixed fabrics and an optional direct drain. E energy rated, 10-year parts warranty.
